newsitem.title: UK: Carlton contender for Rank unit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Carlton contender for Rank unit - paper.

text.p: Carlton Communications Plc, the UK media group, is one of the contenders for Rank Group Plc's film distribution business, said a report in The Times on Friday.
Carlton would neither confirm or deny it was one of the bidders for the business which was placed up for sale last week, said The Times.
Industry estimates say the value of the business could be between 50 and 100 million stg.
Films on the Rank catalogue include the classic Ealing comedies, and the Carry On series as well as more high-brow titles including the Madness of King George and Henry V with Lord Olivier.
